title: You choose what happens to the portal login when two contacts are merged
text: Before, merging two contacts always deleted the login of the contact being removed, even when that was the only login that worked, and the person was locked out. The Logins step of the merge window now lets you choose. If only the removed contact has a login, you pick between moving it to the kept contact (same email and password) or removing it, and the Merge button stays off until you pick. If both contacts have a login, you choose which one the person keeps using. The window shows what will happen to each login, and nothing is deleted until the login you want to keep has been moved and checked. If the move fails the merge screen says so and no login is deleted.
points: Open a contact, press Delete / Merge, pick the other contact
In the Logins step, choose which login the person keeps using
Type MERGE. The chosen login now belongs to the kept contact

steps.name: See both logins
steps.detail: The Logins step lists each login and what will happen to it.

steps.name: You choose
steps.detail: Move the removed contact's login, keep the kept one, or remove it.

steps.name: The chosen login moves first
steps.detail: It is pointed at the kept contact and read back to check.

steps.name: Only then are the others deleted
steps.detail: If the move fails, nothing is deleted.
